amendment2.note: Amendment 2's corrections stand. Amendment 3 fixes eight defects found in reviewing Amendment 2's contracts before execution, and does not reinterpret what Amendment 2 got right.

preregistrationSha256.why: Amendment 2 duplicated the digest into this file, which then had to be kept in sync by hand. It lives in exactly one authoritative place.

stage1ContractManifestAggregate.why: The aggregate covers every governed file. Writing it into a file the manifest itself hashes would be self-referential: recording it would change the value being recorded. It lives on the manifest's own trailing `# aggregate` line, which the manifest excludes from its own file list.
